new_learnings.text: When breadth collapses below 1:1 and all three major indices are red, even a rich menu of valid-looking momentum names should resolve to zero new positions.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector pockets can still print gains, but poor breadth means follow-through odds on fresh longs drop sharply and adverse selection rises.

new_learnings.text: The anti-chase MA-distance rule is again doing real work: many of the strongest RPS names today fail because they are too far above MA10/MA20, especially in 通信设备、半导体、电池.
new_learnings.mechanism: High-RPS names can still be bad entries when extension is extreme; waiting for support retests improves reward/risk without fighting the trend.

new_learnings.text: Cleaner setups like 科达制造 and 伟测科技 can remain actionable on the watch-through list even on no-trade days; the regime filter and the setup filter should stay separate.
new_learnings.mechanism: A stock can be technically buyable in isolation, but the market can still say 'not today'; separating stock quality from tape quality prevents forced entries.
